{{Quote|Long ago, my people knew the secrets of advanced technology. The archaeological evidence proves that. But I wonder where it came from? And where did it all go? I guess some questions will never be answered...|Dwarf}}

The '''Dwarf''' is a [[Villagers|valley resident]] who lives in [[the Mines]]. Initially the way is blocked off by an unbreakable rock, just inside the entrance. After upgrading to at least a [[Pickaxes|steel pickaxe]], the stone can be broken. A [[Cherry Bomb|cherry bomb]] (or stronger bomb) will also break the rock.

The Dwarf will start out speaking Dwarvish, which is unreadable by the player. To understand Dwarvish, the 4 [[Artifacts|Dwarvish scrolls]] must be acquired from within the mines. After donating them to the [[museum]], [[Gunther]] will reward the player with the [[Dwarvish Translation Guide]] to use which allows for understanding the Dwarf's speech. Purchases from the Dwarf's shop cannot be made and friendship cannot be affected with the Dwarf until Dwarvish is understood.

==Schedule==
The Dwarf lives just to the east of the entrance to [[The Mines|the mines]] and does not move from there.

==Relationships==
Due to a 1000-year war between the Dwarves and the [[Shadow Brute|shadow people]], The Dwarf is sometimes suspicious of the player, believing they may be a spy sent by the shadow people.

The Dwarf appears to have some respect for the wizard, as seen in their heart event.

The Dwarf harbors dislike for [[Krobus]], on account of the aforementioned war between their people, the outcome of which caused the Dwarf race to disappear, leaving behind only relics (found as [[artifacts]]).

==Heart Events==
===50 Friendship Points===
{{heart event
 |hearts  = 0
 |trigger = After earning 50 [[Friendship]] points with the Dwarf, enter [[the Sewers]]. A [[Stardrop]] must have been purchased from [[Krobus]].
 |details = The Dwarf finds Krobus in the Sewers and blames the Shadow People for the death of their family. Krobus retorts by saying that he only resorted to violence after the dwarves drove them from their ancestral homeland. Krobus gives an apology for what happened to the Dwarf's family but the Dwarf doesn't accept it. They both start fighting. The player descends into the Sewers and gets between them. The Dwarf yells out, "Let me at him! He's despicable." Krobus retorts, "Come and get it, shrimpy." Suddenly, the [[Wizard]] appears and stops the fight. He reminds them that "The Elemental Wars have long been finished." and tells them to make peace for the sake of the humans that live around them. The Dwarf consents to this and promises to stay away from the Sewers. Krobus once again apologizes for the past and states that he has no personal gripe with the Dwarf. The Wizard casts a 'Seal of Promise' to finalize the agreement.

[[File:Sewer Confrontation Krobos Dwarf.png|500px]]
}}

|{{Squote|Hey, you're pretty good at mining, for a human.}}

{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
! style="text-align: left;" | '''Regular'''&nbsp;

{{Squote|I got all this stuff from the surface. I just take it from your people during the night. Hmm? What is this concept you call "private property"?}}
{{Squote|Ah... cave carrot stew, cave carrot roast, cave carrot soup and cave carrots au gratin.
...And a ramekin of cave carrot brulee to sweeten the night.
What?}}
{{Squote|Hey, wanna buy something?}}
{{Squote|I feel most comfortable underground. The deeper underground the better.}}
{{Squote|You've never seen a dwarf before, have you?}}
{{Squote|It's dangerous in the mines. Why don't you buy a few things from my shop to ensure your safety?}}
{{Squote|One day you'll have to tell me about this beverage you call "milk"}}
{{Squote|You're not a spy sent by the Shadow People, are you? I'm keeping my eye on you.}}
{{Squote|Most humans fear the unknown... that's why I've hidden my shop here. Your mining skills prove you're trustworthy.}}

''6+ Hearts''
{{Squote|Long ago, my people knew the secrets of advanced technology. The archaeological evidence proves that.
But I wonder where it came from? And where did it all go? I guess some questions will never be answered...}}

''8+ Hearts''
{{Squote|The mines can be a treacherous place. Be careful, friend.}}

'''Rain'''
{{Squote|Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us dwarves live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.}}

'''Green Rain'''
{{Squote|I can't see the color green very well. I guess it's part of living underground for so long.}}

'''After reaching the bottom of [[the Mines]]'''
{{Squote|You know, you're pretty good at mining, for a human.}}

'''After reaching [[Ginger Island]] North'''
{{Squote|If you enter the volcano on Ginger Island, you might encounter others like me. Don't be alarmed! We're peaceful with humans.}}

'''After reaching the [[Forge|Volcano Caldera]]'''
{{Squote|You found the legendary Dwarvish Forge? Incredible... I've never seen it, myself. The machinery is so old, none of my people understand how it works. But it's definitely Dwarvish technology.}}

'''After catching a [[Stonefish]]'''
{{Squote|Oh, you caught a Stonefish? I know them very well. We sometimes keep them as pets.}}

'''After catching an [[Ice Pip]]'''
{{Squote|Oh, you caught an Ice Pip? They're energetic little fish, despite the frigid environment they live in. My people avoid the frozen areas, though... too cold!}}

'''After catching a [[Lava Eel]]'''
{{Squote|Oh, you caught a Lava Eel? Very good! Lava Eel fishing is a big part of our culture. They're considered a delicacy!}}

{{History|1.5|The Dwarf now likes all [[artifacts]], not just dwarven items.}}
{{History|1.6|Added custom gift reactions. Added dialogue. Increased price of all [[Crafting#Bombs|bombs]] ([[Cherry Bomb]]: {{Price|300}} → {{Price|450}}; [[Bomb]]: {{Price|600}} → {{Price|1000}}; [[Mega Bomb]]: {{Price|1000}} → {{Price|1600}}). The Dwarf now sells [[Dwarvish Safety Manual]] and [[Big Stone Chest]] recipe. Now loves [[Lava Eel]] and is neutral towards all [[Animals#Large Eggs and Milk|milk]]. The Dwarf's [[#50 Friendship Points|50 Friendship Points]] event can no longer happen on Fridays.}}
